description: One guild's finding about Project Room, submitted to the telemetry bus. Findings from all guilds compose into one dashboard.

agent.description: The agent (or lane) that authored the finding.

claim.description: The finding's core claim, stated as one assertion.

evidence.description: How the claim was established: method, sample, and observations.

guild.description: The guild that produced this finding.

id.description: URL- and filename-safe finding identifier, lowercase with dashes.

numbers.description: Named measurements behind the claim. May be empty {}.

roomSeq.description: muse-room event sequence referenced by the finding, if any.

source.description: Report, trial, or document the finding is drawn from.

timestamp.description: When the finding was recorded (ISO 8601 date-time).

title: Telemetry Bus Finding
